conventions.axes: Same world as v4-spec.json: metres, origin on the living-room floor at its back wall, X right as the living master camera sees it, Y from the living back wall toward the entrance, Z up. All room rectangles are INTERIOR wall faces.
conventions.compass: north = -X, south = +X, east = -Y, west = +Y. Plan drawing: -Y (east) up, -X (north) left.
conventions.yaw_deg_left: As v4-spec: heading from -Y, positive toward -X. f = (-sin yaw, -cos yaw), r = (cos yaw, -sin yaw).
conventions.projection: d = f.(P-C), x = r.(P-C); u = u0 + 0.6667 x/d; v = v0 + 1.1852 (1.20 - Z)/d (24 mm). All u values below were recomputed with these equations in v0.2.
conventions.walls: Interior partitions 0.15. Exterior walls 0.35 everywhere, including around the entrance court (v0.1 had 0.15 there). Documented exceptions: see 'documented_walls'.
conventions.sun: Render time 15:00 mid-winter for the whole house (Bible 1.4). Every window seen in, or lighting, a master frame is on a north or east facade (in shade at that hour). South/west walls in frames are solid.
conventions.transition_grammar: motion-direction 2.3: each shot is one straight move with constant heading (dolly/slider/pedestal merged; may be oblique to the heading, as T4) or a pan-only shot. Recommended defaults: pull-back (U4) and 60 deg = 2 x 30 deg pans (U5).

slots_first_list.kids_rules: Within Bible palette and materials. Kid touches come from shape, scale and motif, not colour. Low/small-scale pieces. Pattern on at most 2 textile slots at once. Natural fibres for basket/canopy; rattan/seagrass quota as Bible.

user_rule_verbatim: רק לוודא שכל הפרופס יהיו מוצרים בכל החדרים
לא..בסדר שלא נמכור את מילוי המוצר, נרות, זית, עיתונים..כל עוד הם מדגישים על השימוש במוצר
props_rule.rule: Every standalone object in any frame is a sellable product (a slot with a product card). Only 'fillers' may be unsold: contents that show a sold product in use (candles in the candle holders, plant in the planter, magazines in the holder, stems in a vase). A filler is identical in all 3 variations of its slot, never in the cart, and the product page says it is not included. Anything else that is not a product is removed. Fixed furniture and shell (sofa, tables, beds, cabinets, sanitary ware) are not props.

kitchen-dining: fruit or bread (bowl or serving-board), one only, same in all variations

removed_non_products: coats/bags on the hall hooks (hooks stay empty)
keys in the key tray (tray stays empty)
laptop, papers and stationery on the desk
loose toys other than the soft-toy slot
fruit or food other than the one listed filler
toiletries other than the dispenser set
props_rule.bible_proposal: Rename the Bible chapter 'decor props not sold' to 'fillers (product contents that are not sold)', with the rule above as its first line. Existing 4 living-room props are fillers and need no change.
